description: Pierre Morey's 2013 Bourgogne Chardonnay offers a mature white Burgundy profile shaped by orchard fruit, citrus, and gentle nutty development. The palate is rounded yet held in line by clean acidity and a chalky, understated finish.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2013 Domaine Pierre Morey Bourgogne Chardonnay.
palate: Rounded orchard fruit, bright acidity, light cream
sommelierNotes: Serve at 11-12°C without overchilling; pair with roast chicken, sole meunière, or a creamy mushroom dish.
